title: Spin-Momentum Impedance and Filtering by a Spin-Coupled Absorbing Boundary Condition
summary: Absorbing boundaries are often treated as scalar sinks. Here we show that a spin-coupled absorbing boundary for a Pauli particle acts instead as a spin--momentum impedance. Its tangential boundary symbol has two branches, $iκ\pm|\boldsymbolξ|$, coupling normal absorption to in-plane momentum. In a harmonic guide, the transverse ground state samples $|\boldsymbolξ|\sim \ell_\perp^{-1}\sim\sqrtω$; narrowing the guide therefore strengthens a local evanescent boundary response without introducing a bulk potential barrier.
